// Raw C# declaration fixture for the .NET inventory analyzer.
// This file uses the .txt suffix so no tooling treats it as real C# source.
// It contains named positive cases for namespace and type detection plus
// false-positive traps. No consumer identifiers appear anywhere.

// Trap: a declaration-shaped line inside a line comment must NOT match.
// namespace Fake

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

// Block-form namespace with a dotted name and an opening brace on the same line.
namespace Alpha.Beta
{
    // Trap: declaration-shaped text inside a string literal must NOT match.
    public static class LiteralTrap
    {
        private const string Sample = "class InString and namespace AlsoFake";
    }

    // Plain class with a modifier stack.
    public sealed class WidgetContainer
    {
    }

    // Struct declaration.
    public struct PointValue
    {
    }

    // Interface declaration.
    public interface IProcessor
    {
    }

    // Enum declaration.
    public enum StatusCode
    {
        Ready,
        Busy,
    }

    // Record declaration (normalizes to record).
    public record PersonInfo(string Name);

    // Record class declaration (normalizes to record).
    public record class AccountInfo(int Id);

    // Record struct declaration (normalizes to record_struct).
    public readonly record struct Measurement(double Amount);

    // Attribute line preceding a generic type declaration.
    [Serializable]
    public class Repository<TEntity>
    {
        // Nested type inside a generic type.
        public class Cursor
        {
        }
    }

    // Generic type with two type parameters.
    public class Pair<TFirst, TSecond>
    {
    }

    // Partial type: two declaration sites for the same logical type.
    public partial class SplitService
    {
    }

    public partial class SplitService
    {
    }
}

// Nested block namespace: an independent namespace declaration line.
namespace Alpha.Beta.Gamma
{
    internal abstract class BaseHandler
    {
    }
}

// File-scoped namespace form (C# 10) would normally be file-terminal; it is
// placed last here so the block forms above remain well-formed for the fixture.
namespace Delta.Epsilon;

public class FileScopedResident
{
}
